title: Cauthon Lightup
description: Cauthon Lightup, Adds a client-side hotkey for night vision toggle.
body:
## Cauthon Lightup
This mod allows you to toggle a night vision effect in Minecraft using a keyboard key,
Default hotkey is "N"

You can use this in both singleplayer and multiplayer, Its client-side.

We have a discord now!!! [https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD](https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD)
